slice: canonical taxonomy skill facet in Jobs saved searches

implemented: Jobs loads its Skill options from the current server-side canonical taxonomy; All skills is the default and no technology is mandatory.
The API canonicalizes supported aliases with canonical_skill_id and rejects unsupported values.
Database filtering matches exact normalized skill IDs or exact canonical labels before LIMIT; missing and unrecognized skills do not match a known selection.
The facet AND-composes with query/location and saved semantic requirements; contradictory criteria return no rows.
Saved searches normalize and retain the facet per profile, support legacy payloads, restore after reload, and clear the control and persisted value.
Connected readback showed the selected skill in request/results; no discovery scheduling or application/submission side effects were observed.
